title: skills: objectstack-data security.md states the old grant key and never mentions permission_set_package
body:
domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaP1iy4RSEQbW6177G

立卡门 ① · 已落地工作欠的后续：#32164 P2（PR #32306）dev 报告 6813351213 与契约审查 6813617327 ③ 点名的 skills 文档余项。Part of #31527 (ADR-0150)。Blocked-by #32306.

Blocked-by: #32306

## What

`skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md` says one grant per user, set and organization is enforced by the `unique: 'organization'` index and does not mention `permission_set_package`. After PR #32306 the key is `(user_id, permission_set, permission_set_package, organization_id)` with a package-less guard, a grant may name its holder's package, and a name two packages hold must be granted with the package (`409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` with candidates otherwise).

## Acceptance

- The rule text states the four-column key, the package-less guard, and when an author must name `permission_set_package`; it does not promise more than the changeset of #32306 declares (driver-memory not enforced).
- The skills lane's own gates pass.

## 业务理由

谁受益：照 skill 写授权元数据和种子数据的客户与 agent。场景：多包环境里给用户授予同名权限集。不做：按 skill 写出的授予不带包，#31698 PR-2 后被 409 拒收，skill 却说一条 `unique` 就够。

## 读者

`domain:skills` 车道，#32306 合并后；起点 `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md`。

## 查重

`repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue objectstack-data security.md permission set grant unique` → 10 hits; open only #32164; the closed #31819 #23615 #23513 fixed other sentences. No duplicate.
